texts.zh:
我们劫掠者氏族的残兵败将找上了门。看来在我们家园沦陷后，他们倒觉得忘记我们曾被流放的事实很方便。他们的请求很简单：“接任大汗之位，将我们族人的名号烙印在所有伤害过我们的人的星空之上。”

虽然这支舰队的规模比不上任何真正的大汗国，但他们所提供的正是我们曾经渴求的一切。而我们唯一要做的，就是宣布整个星系皆为我们的敌人。
texts.en:
The ragged remains of our marauder clans have come to us. It seems after the fall of our home it was convenient for them to forget our exile. Their plea is simple, "Take the seat of Grand Khan, and burn the name of our people into the stars of all those who wronged us."

Though smaller than any proper Grand Khanate fleet, what they offer is still everything we once wanted. All we have to do is declare the entire galaxy our enemy.

label.en: Let sound the drums of war!

label.zh: 我们不感兴趣，找别的傻瓜去吧。
label.en: We are not interested, find some other fool.
